args.command: echo '=== HEAD ==='; git -c safe.directory=/opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime -C /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime rev-parse HEAD 2>&1 || true; echo '=== UPDATER MTIME ==='; stat -c '%y %U:%G %a %n' /usr/local/sbin/zen-ops-update 2>&1 || true; echo '=== HEARTBEAT CODE ==='; grep -n 'updater-heartbeat\|UPDATER_HEAD\|ROOM_STATE' /usr/local/sbin/zen-ops-update 2>&1 || true; echo '=== SERVICE LAST ==='; systemctl show zen-ops-updater.service -p ExecMainCode -p ExecMainStatus -p Result -p InactiveExitTimestamp --no-pager 2>&1 || true; echo '=== HEARTBEAT FILE ==='; ls -l /var/lib/zen-ops/public/updater-heartbeat.json 2>&1 || true

meta.summary: Inspect live updater deployment and heartbeat code only
